title: Enterprise/private go‑live orchestration: roles, telemetry & key lifecycle
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: Coordinate a safe, auditable go‑live for enterprise Private/VPC/on‑prem deployments that require RBAC, audit logging, and KMS integration. This ticket owns the end‑to‑end orchestration of release assets (release notes, runbooks, support playbooks), cross‑team signoffs, and the first three customer enablements. Key outcomes: 1) clear release notes and changelog sections for security/compliance teams, 2) a validated production runbook with rollback criteria and test checklist, 3) enablement materials and webinar for customer success and sales engineers, and 4) traceable evidence for SOC2/HIPAA requests.
acceptance_criteria: RBAC: role templates published and documented; PM-approved least-privilege examples for Admin/Operator/Observer
Audit logs: ingestion format and retention matrix documented; sample SIEM integration tested with two internal customers
KMS: key rotation doc + HSM integration guide available; automated credential binding validated in staging
Release notes: security and upgrade impacts section reviewed by Security and Compliance and included in public/private notes
Runbook: step-by-step go/no-go checklist and rollback procedure validated in canary deploy with SRE
Enablement: two recorded walkthroughs and a live training session scheduled with CS and SEs before GA
Compliance artifacts: evidence package prepared for SOC2 audit (config snapshots, access logs, signoffs)

risk_mitigation: Fallback policy: if KMS integration fails during customer onboarding, automatically fall back to customer-provided envelope keys and mark deployment as limited-support
Staged rollout: start with two pilot customers (low-risk), validate telemetry, then expand to wider cohort
Monitoring: instrument bespoke SLOs for private deployments and alert on audit-forwarding failures
Customer comms: prepare templated incident communications and escalation matrix for sensitive customers
